approval_rejection.reason: Automatic approval review rejected the run because the user's retained CI gate keeps multi-minute churn/endurance workloads blocked while native CI is pending.
approval_rejection.exact_message: This starts a 120-second, three-node persistent endurance workload while the user’s retained instructions explicitly keep multi-minute churn/endurance runs gated on native CI completion, which is still pending.
approval_rejection.response: No retry or indirect workaround. Wait for the required CI jobs to complete successfully; continue permitted static review and short regressions.

limitations: Bounded loopback regtest only; no public-network or production-readiness claim.
Native automatic-validation 120s fixture failed the unchanged GUI heartbeat threshold at 1278ms; controlled -par=1 passed. Root cause is not conclusively established.
Native process RSS/CPU samples cover the mining phase, not every startup/post-mining verification interval.

The extended run had seven connection observations over one second (max12.824s), maxRPCbatch4.672s and a max29.206s sampler gap with observed cgroup throttling; these results do not establish a latency guarantee or a conclusive root cause.
RPC-generated endurance blocks are not native CPU mining; native qualifier results are separate.
Whole-node queue/worker internals are measured by controlled probe/barrier tests, not an expensive production polling RPC.
Stage A timings and Ryzen owner-hardware performance are not directly comparable to this cloud host.
Windows persistence remains unsupported/fail-closed; independent AKE review, B3, GPU hardware, public discovery/testnet, mainnet genesis/activation remain open.
